responsibility: This header defines the core enumerations used by m68k target option handling: uarch_type for tuning microarchitectures and target_device for specific CPUs. It builds those enums directly from m68k-microarchs.def and m68k-devices.def, giving generated option tables and backend code a shared type-safe representation of parsed -mtune and -mcpu values. The file is thus the central C interface between declarative option data and m68k backend option logic.
